Container.Name: Wise-Wren
Container.Overview:
Wise Wren keeps the Docker containers on your servers up to date, without surprises. One small Rust binary with SQLite.
It finds what runs on each server (containers, Unraid template containers, Compose stacks and script-updated stacks), checks the registries for new versions on your schedule and tells you through ~40 notification services (ntfy, email, Discord and more). It updates only what you approve, now or at a time you choose, or what you explicitly allow inside an automatic window. Every update: the new image pulled first, a snapshot of the data, a health check after, and an automatic rollback if it fails. With Vigilant Vole 0.9.0 or later, updates open maintenance windows and use your monitors as part of the health check.
This is the server (web UI, API, database). Each Docker host also needs the Wise Wren Agent template; add the server under Servers in Wren first to get its token.
Also: a REST API with OpenAPI, MCP tools, users with roles and two-factor sign-in, 26 languages.
Setup: open the WebUI after the first start and create the admin account. Set WW_PUBLIC_URL to the address the agents use. Snapshots are rollback points, not backups: keep your own backups. Everything lives in /data (appdata).
Container.Requires: Early release (v0.1). Each server Wren looks after needs the Wise Wren Agent container.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface, REST API, MCP and the agents' endpoint.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: wren.sqlite, the session key (which also seals registry passwords and the Vigilant Vole token) and pre-migration backups. Ownership is set to PUID:PGID on every start.

Config.Name: WW_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address agents and people use, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3003 or https://wren.example.com. Used in the agents' docker run lines and notification links. Without it, each request's own address is used.

Config.Name: WW_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 when Wren is reached through a reverse proxy or tunnel (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Pangolin) that sets X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: WW_SETUP_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the first-run /setup page only opens with ?token=VALUE, so nobody else can create the admin account.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps (pages use Settings, General, time zone).
